sources.entry: EveningHoney.ai - Experience immersive relationships with AI girlfriends and virtual companions. Chat, receive images & videos, make phone calls, and dive into realistic relationships. #freemium

summary.name: EveningHoney.AI
summary.one_liner: EveningHoney.AI is a web service for chatting with AI companion characters (girlfriends, boyfriends, and other relationship types) that can send images, videos, and phone calls.
use_cases: Chatting with an AI companion late at night
Making phone calls with a virtual girlfriend or boyfriend
Receiving AI-generated selfies, images, and videos from a character
Designing a custom AI companion from scratch
Roleplaying a romantic or companion relationship
summary.what_it_does: The page lists a large set of AI companion characters, each with a short backstory and tags such as personality or relationship style. Users can chat with these characters, receive images and videos, and make phone calls with them. A character creator lets users customize appearance, voice, personality, and relationship type. The site says companions can send spontaneous selfies and messages and adapt to user preferences over time. The FAQ states that chat data is encrypted in transit and at rest, with strong authentication.
notable: Character creator for building a custom companion's looks, voice, and personality
Phone calls, chat, images and videos within one companion service
Companions send proactive selfies and messages
First messages and images are free, per the page
caveats: Page says first messages and images are free; further use appears to be paid, but pricing details are not on the page
Content is sexually suggestive and romance-focused, per the character listings and tags
Platform availability beyond the website is not stated
